subject: Citi becomes latest US bank to restrict AI agents from accessing accounts
text:
Source: FT, 16 Oct https://www.ft.com/content/f49c8e39-f07f-4177-9948-aabe55e5ed91 (paywalled; Site Watch confirmed headline and summary via FT RSS)
Why it fits: big-bank AI policy on the top beat; a separate event from the 14 Oct JPMorgan brief. The FT page returns HTTP 403 to source.mjs: brief it only from a readable source (FT feed entry via source.mjs, Reuters, American Banker or Citi itself), or decline.
